learning_outcomes.text: To understand and study the automatic control of systems and industrial regulation.
To know how to apply the operational approach to continuous-time invariant linear systems.

syllabus_topics: Operational calculation and notion of transfer function
Basic systems: first-order, second-order and delay system
Frequency study of systems. Stability, precision
Performances analysis and improvement of root locus of linear dynamic system
teaching_methods: Lab sessions (simulation with Matlab and Simulink)
institution: ISAE-ENSMA (École nationale supérieure de mécanique et d'aérotechnique)
